title: Gura Gura no Mi
facts: Appearance (main One Piece Wiki, via search): a blue pear with a 'cracked' lower part; an official design was published in October 2025 (not viewable from here, so the drawing is unconfirmed)
Paramecia, English name Tremor-Tremor Fruit: the user creates vibrations / shockwaves ('quakes')
Whitebeard wraps his fist in a bubble-like shockwave and cracks the air like glass (Marineford)
At Marineford, Whitebeard's quakes split the island in two and raised two giant tidal waves
Whitebeard grabbed the air and tilted the sea around Marineford (Marineford arc)
Fleet Admiral Sengoku said the power could destroy the world
After Whitebeard died at Marineford, Blackbeard took the fruit's power from him (method unexplained)
'Never need a massage chair' is a joke line
